views.markdown: An experimental fork of **IPARanger** (a GUI for `ipatool` that downloads IPAs from the App Store). Made for personal use and experimentation — shared as-is, not a replacement for the original.

- Multi-account support, isolated `ipatool` keychain per account
- Version selection before download, with release dates
- Fallback to latest when history isn't available
- Minimum-iOS and account attribution metadata on downloaded IPAs
- Non-blocking in-app download banner
- Login-screen shortcut to the downloads folder even when auth is broken
- Patched embedded `ipatool` to reduce recurring auth / JSON errors
Tested on rootless (Dopamine, iOS 16.4) and limited rootful (iOS 13.5). Experimental — rough edges expected. Pick the build matching your jailbreak.
